faqPage.ctaBody: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Please get in touch with our support team.

items.a: Bio Vera is a vertically integrated agricultural network: we connect producers with markets under one operating model—traceability, quality assurance, and compliance from field to buyer, worldwide.

items.q: How does Bio Vera ensure product quality?
items.a: We use our Protocol 360 system, which includes three levels of quality control: field-level soil analysis (Eco-Safe Audit), biometric scanning at packaging centers, and cold chain monitoring during transport. Every product is verified before reaching the market.

items.q: What certifications does Bio Vera support?
items.a: We facilitate GlobalG.A.P. IFA v6 group certification and ensure all products meet international and EU market standards. Our systems support certification management and compliance tracking globally.

items.q: How do I become a Bio Vera producer?
items.a: You can apply through our Growers page. The application process includes providing information about your farm, certifications, and production capacity. Our team will review your application and guide you through onboarding.

items.q: What are the requirements to become a producer?
items.a: Producers need to have valid agricultural operations, comply with EU standards, and be willing to implement our quality control protocols. GlobalG.A.P. certification is preferred but we can help you obtain it.

Payments are processed automatically upon successful delivery verification. We use an escrow system to ensure secure transactions. Farmers receive payment within 3–5 business days after delivery confirmation.

items.q: How do I place an order?
items.a: Create a buyer account, browse available products, and place orders through Bio Vera. You can track your orders in real time and receive digital certificates for each delivery.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
items.a: Minimum order quantities vary by product and producer. You can see specific requirements when browsing products. We support both retail and wholesale orders.

items.q: How can I verify product authenticity?
items.a: Every product has a QR code that links to its digital passport. Scan the code to see complete traceability information, including origin, farmer details, quality certifications, and transport history.

items.q: How do I become a logistics partner?
items.a: Apply through our Logistics Partner page. We welcome independent drivers, small vans, and larger transport companies. Requirements include valid licenses, GPS tracking capability, and commitment to cold chain compliance.

items.q: What is the Bio Vera: From Orchard to Shelf program?
items.a: This program requires logistics partners to take end-to-end responsibility for transport, from farm pickup to final delivery. You ensure complete cold chain integrity, GPS tracking, and digital handover at every stage.

Partners receive automated payments upon successful delivery verification. Payment amounts are based on distance, cargo type, and delivery requirements. All payments are processed digitally with no paperwork delays.
Yes, we have mobile applications for growers and logistics partners. The apps support offline functionality, GPS tracking, barcode scanning, and real-time synchronization when online.

items.q: How does the traceability system work?
items.a: Our system uses immutable digital records, GPS timestamps, device fingerprinting, and QR codes to create an unbreakable chain of custody. Every step from field to shelf is recorded and verifiable.

items.q: What security measures are in place?
items.a: We use end-to-end encryption, role-based access controls, multi-factor authentication, and regular security audits. All data is stored securely and complies with GDPR regulations.

pressPage.aboutTitle: How the company explains its model to editors
aboutParagraphs: HAMBURG, Germany. When Bio Vera refers to a vertical agricultural network it does not mean another layer that connects growers and shoppers through loosely tied channels. Bio Vera presents itself as one integrated operating model whose steps—from cultivation to the labelled pack on shelf—sit inside a single documented system.

Registered as an agricultural brand, the company maintains a contiguous production trace from cultivation rules through to shelf-facing goods so every downstream step—including sourcing—rides the same system: clear, joined-up and transparent.

Key inputs—including seed, packaging and anything the approved worksheet names—route through contracted suppliers organised locally or, where economies demand it, at regional hubs. Procurement runs through the Bio Vera application: each purchase connects to crop-cycle records so supply-side entries track field activity.

Packing carries a Bio Vera badge bearing a QR shortcut; scanning opens the product passport spanning production cues, farmer identity, lifecycle logs and QA checkpoints reachable to shoppers and supervisory bodies wherever statute requires transparency.

Backend systems capture activity digitally; where configuration allows it, batch evidence may optionally publish to public verification networks such as the Polygon ledger per internal Bio Vera operations documents.
keyFacts: Registered agricultural brand with an integrated system from parcel to shelf-ready packs.
One digital dossier aligning production sourcing and onward distribution workflows.
Contracted suppliers plus digitised procurement through the Bio Vera app.
QR-coded badge unlocking the product’s digital passport on scan.
Evidence-grade verification—including optional blockchain anchoring wherever configuration enables it.

releases.title: Protocol 360: Bio Vera introduces a three-layer quality control programme from field to shelf
releases.summary: Protocol 360 is Bio Vera’s internal, measurable control model: Eco-Safe auditing in the field, biometric and visual checks at packing, and Logistics Guard during transport—on one digital backbone for traceable lots through to retail.
paragraphs: HAMBURG, Germany — 2026. Bio Vera formally announced Protocol 360, an in-house three-tier quality programme spanning the production chain—from parcel line to supermarket shelf.
The rollout targets a tighter industry stance on combining product-safety controls, technical conformance and exhaustive documentation throughout every processing step.
It is designed for repeatable measurable assurance versus ad-hoc note-taking: a single dossier follows product from first crop interactions through trucking and eventual shelf positioning.
As an integration layer, Protocol 360 promises repeatable measurable safety outcomes, harmonised QA practices and exhaustive batch trace.
Three control strata—single doctrine: Protocol 360 expresses itself through delineated checkpoints.

Tier 1 — Eco-Safe audit (parcel / pre-harvest): first-line monitoring targets agronomic safety ahead of onward handling. Signals include screening for elevated heavy metals, nitrate burdens, substrate pH and moisture balance (tracked at least forty-eight hours pre-harvest). Only lots clearing this hurdle progress.

Tier 2 — biometric & visual scan (pack-house): second-line checks capture physical fidelity before containers exit—calibration of calibre, pulp firmness, wrap integrity plus chromatic deltas (normally within about five percent). Goal: surface defects upstream of freight.

Tier 3 — Logistics Guard (movement & warehousing): third-line stewardship keeps refrigerated lanes honest—typically two to eight degrees Celsius wherever the worksheet prescribes—and raises automated alarms if contractual bands slip, preserving dossier continuity until store delivery.
Protocol 360 rides Bio Vera’s shared digital spine: auditors and contractual partners ingest synchronised shipment views wherever law permits, retaining transparent custody.
The initiative frames QA as observable outcomes—not assumed compliance—elevating reassurance for shoppers, clarity for growers and reliability for collaborators.
“Protocol 360 is Bio Vera’s next evolution—we want each unit routed through measurable, accountable controls—from field handshake to chilled shelf placement.”
Brand scaffolding highlights Standards Beyond Expectation · Controlled by Science, Grown by Nature · Every Unit a Masterpiece.

To review a publicly exposed batch dossier assemble the workbook URL pattern biovera.app/protocol-360?batchId=YOUR_BATCH_ID swapping YOUR_BATCH_ID for the worksheet identifier surfaced on each passport slice.
Bio Vera architects digital stewardship for agrifood traceability bridging growers, logistics and retail storefronts beneath one playbook. Headquarters: Hamburg, Germany.
Media: press@biovera.app · https://biovera.app

releases.title: Bio Vera launches integrated digital infrastructure for transparent, traceable food production
releases.summary: The programme links farm workflows, QA controls and market release: QR-backed digital passports, the Bio Vera Standard, grower assistance and final checks before shipments are cleared—with a phased rollout from early 2026 toward additional regions including the United States, paced by approvals and onboarding in each geography.
paragraphs: HAMBURG, Germany — Bio Vera launches an integrated digital programme aimed at transparency and traceability throughout food production—from farm to consumer.
Unlike single-purpose apps, Bio Vera is pitched as one operating umbrella that binds cultivation, logistics and retail workflows under identical technical rails.

Modern tooling logs critical steps so both farms and downstream buyers see auditable dossiers—not isolated PDFs or empty slogans—and supervisory bodies can reconcile the same files where statutes require disclosure.

The headline consumer touchpoint remains the batch passport unlocked by QR codes pointing to origins, farmer profiles, field activity—including photo evidence when the worksheet mandates it—and timestamps alongside inspection visits.
Shoppers receive a cohesive storyline for each lot while auditors rely on paired documentation pathways whenever jurisdiction demands it.

The Bio Vera Standard mandates guided cultivation with mandatory digitised diary entries from the parcel, recurring field audits, conformance scoring tied to contractual growing and dossiers that persist through onward handling worksheets.
Confidence rests on worksheet-backed telemetry and inspection trails—not unsubstantiated marketing lines.
Compared with basic buy-side contracts growers receive sharper market linkage, articulated standards across the cycle plus orchestrated distribution corridors once conformance is proven.
Once harvest closes and documentation proves programme compliance, field obligations end under the ruleset and downstream logistics continue on Bio Vera’s contracted operating plan.
Additional margin can come from on-farm packing where the standard allows: goods stay traceable closer to the source, trimming redundant handling layers that add no auditable value.
Final QA aligns Bio Vera’s control tower with agronomy field staff and freight coordination before lots enter European retail programmes as fully documented batches.
End-to-end the chain behaves as cultivation → supervisory checks → worksheet-bound packing → cold-chain logistics → retail with one journal mirroring custody changes.

Technically the stack combines digitised field operations, GPS time-stamps, activity ledgers, QR labelling and data-protection guardrails so purchasers see evidence-led readouts—not hero claims alone.
Expansion beyond the current European focus—including stated goals for the United States between late 2027 and 2028—remains subject to regulatory clearance in each market.
Leadership frames the vision as stronger buyer trust, contractual safeguards for growers and a more inspectable food supply chain overall.

“Bio Vera is not just another app—it is the system that connects production, quality control and retail. Our goal is to use technology to deliver transparency and assurance for everyone in the chain.”
Bio Vera is an agri-technology company building digital trace-infrastructure for food production. Registered office: Hamburg, Germany. Media contact: press@biovera.app · https://biovera.app
— Bio Vera communications

cookieConsent.mainBanner: We use essential cookies so our sites and apps work (login, security, your consent choice). cookieConsent.fullListFooter: Full list of cookies, retention periods, and third-party services: <1>Cookie Policy</1>. How we use data: <2>Privacy Policy</2>.

essential.title: Essential Cookies
essential.subtitle: Required for the services to function
essential.p1: Necessary for the site to work. They cannot be disabled.
essential.d1t: Login session, authentication token (JWT), security (e.g. CSRF), load balancing, and storing this consent choice.
essential.d2t: Session ID, token (in localStorage), cookie-consent and cookie-consent-date (localStorage).
essential.d3t: Session (until you close the browser) or up to 1 year for persistent ones (e.g. consent).

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
analytics.subtitle: Help us understand how you use Bio Vera
analytics.p1: Help us understand how our services are used so we can improve them.
analytics.d1t: Anonymous statistics: page views, navigation paths, device type, and performance (e.g. load times). No identification of individuals.
analytics.d2t: Analytics cookies from tools we may use (e.g. page view counters, session duration).
analytics.d3t: Up to 2 years, depending on the tool. You can turn this category off at any time.

functionality.title: Functionality Cookies
functionality.subtitle: Remember your preferences and settings
functionality.p1: Remember your choices and settings for a more convenient experience.
functionality.d1t: Language, region, display options (e.g. theme), accessibility settings, and temporary form data to avoid data loss.
functionality.d2t: preference_*, language, theme, or similar identifiers stored in localStorage/sessionStorage.
functionality.d3t: Up to 1 year or until you clear site data.

marketing.title: Marketing Cookies
marketing.subtitle: Used for advertising and marketing purposes
marketing.p1: Used for advertising and measuring campaign effectiveness, if we use such tools in the future.
marketing.d1t: Personalized ads and measurement of ad performance (e.g. conversions). May involve third-party ad partners.
marketing.d2t: Advertising or marketing cookies set by us or our partners, if we enable them.
marketing.d3t: As per the relevant provider; typically up to 2 years. You can withdraw consent at any time.

compliancePhotos.explainerTitle: What is Sticker Roll ID (not “per box” or “per pallet”)?

growerPages.sf3t: 3. Official stock & barcodes in the app
growerPages.sf3: On <0>Materials</0>, use <1>Purchase</1> so the platform updates <2>Crates</2>, <3>Label rolls</3>, and <4>Film</4>, and (for each label roll) stores a <5>serial</5> you will quote on <6>Compliance photos</6>. If you only source stock offline, work with your partner or support so balances match reality. Large orders: repeat purchase or use multiple runs (e.g. max 200 units per in-app order).
growerPages.sf4: Announce work and form lots in <0>My Batches</0> and field tools; follow packing and traceability in the app.
growerPages.sf5: You need enough official material for the shipment, compliance photos, and quality entry. Then use <0>Request transport</0> — the app checks that packaging / materials rules are met for the lot.
growerPages.sfCompactAnd: your serials and stock; one process.
growerPages.sfCompactHelp: Partner locations show after admin approval. Need help?

growerPages.plantingsPageLead: Crop plans (planting or expected harvest) are stored here and match the mobile app. They require an admin-approved parcel — same as on “My fields”.
growerPages.plantingsEmpty: No crop plans yet. Register a plan below, or from the Bio Vera grower app.
growerPages.plantingsFormDate: Key date (e.g. expected development or harvest window)
growerPages.plantingsApprovedOnly: You need at least one admin-approved parcel before registering a plan. Open My fields and wait for approval, or contact support.
growerPages.materialsPageDescription: Official crate, label roll, and film balances; purchase below; serial list for compliance photos.
growerPages.materialsBalanceZeroBody: Order using the form below, or if you usually buy through a local distributor, open <0>Suppliers & orders</0> to message them, then ensure your balance here is updated (via purchase or support).
growerPages.materialsWhitelistIntro: Same list as in the mobile app — tap the category first (seed, fertilizer, pesticide, other), then the product name and barcode. Lets you spell out which seed or pack without guessing the type.
growerPages.materialsWhitelistSuccess: Saved. It appears in Materials in the app and in field barcode checks.
growerPages.materialsWhitelistErrRequired: Enter the product name and a barcode with at least 3 characters.
growerPages.materialsWhitelistErrSave: Could not save. This barcode may already exist.
growerPages.materialsPurchaseIntro: Pick <0>crate</0>, <1>label roll</1>, or <2>film</2> (meters) — the three balances above update when the order succeeds.
growerPages.materialsQuantityHint: Max 200 units per order (e.g. 100 label rolls = 100 serial numbers in the system).
growerPages.materialsErrBalance: Could not load your material balance. Check that you are logged in.
growerPages.materialsErrCatalogEmpty: No products in the catalog. Contact your approved supplier in Suppliers & orders, or use Help / contact — an admin may need to enable material types.
growerPages.materialsErrTypesInvalid: Invalid response from the server for material types.
growerPages.materialsErrTypesLoad: Could not load the list of materials. Try again, or go to Suppliers & orders and message your material partner if the list stays empty.
growerPages.materialsErrSelectQty: Please select a material and enter a valid quantity
growerPages.materialsErrMaxQty: Maximum 200 units per order. Lower the quantity and try again.
growerPages.materialsErrPurchaseHint: If this keeps happening, open “Suppliers & orders” to contact your material partner, or use Help / contact.
growerPages.materialsSerialsLoadFailed: Could not load label roll numbers
growerPages.materialsLabelRollTitle: Your label roll IDs (sticker roll ID)
growerPages.materialsLabelRollIntro: Created when you buy <0>label rolls</0>. Use the same value in <1>Compliance photos</1>.
growerPages.materialsLabelRollEmpty: No label rolls in your account yet — purchase at least one above, then the IDs appear here.
growerPages.materialsImportantBody: You can only ship batches using official Bio Vera materials. Make sure you have enough materials before reporting a harvest.
growerPages.fieldsNoParcelsOnEstate: No parcels on this field yet — add a parcel below.
growerPages.fieldDiaryPageLead: Review-only: entries from the grower app. Each line links parcel, crop plan, and proof (photo + GPS). Optional material where used; photos are mandatory for every entry and support the product passport.
growerPages.fieldDiarySyncedBody: Everything listed here is stored on the server — the same journal as in the grower app once entries have synced.
growerPages.fieldDiaryMobileEntryHint: New entries are added in the grower app: parcel → crop plan → optional material → mandatory photo on location + GPS. Aim for photos from sowing onward and at least monthly while the crop is in the field.
growerPages.portalPageDescription: Follow transport runs, route, and status for batches you have moved from the farm.
growerPages.portalWhatIsBody: A <0>mission</0> is a transport run: when you request pickup (from <1>Request transport</1>), logistics gets a job to collect your batch. Here you follow that job — status, route on the map, and after delivery you can see buyer feedback and payout-related info for the selected batch.
growerPages.portalActiveMissionsLead: Open a mission to load the journey map and (when available) ratings and financial status for that batch.
growerPages.portalNetworkError: Network error while loading missions. Check that the API is running and your connection.
growerPages.portalNoMissionsBody: When you mark a batch ready and request transport, the pickup job appears here so you can track driver status and the route.
growerPages.portalNoFeedback: No feedback yet. Check back after delivery!

home.partnersLine: Trusted every day by leading agricultural organizations

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.intro: We build a trusted path from field to buyer: clear rules, honest records, and fair access to market for growers who meet our standards.

cards.title: Transparency
cards.description: Complete visibility of the entire process from field to customer. Every step is documented and immutable.

cards.title: Security
cards.description: Cryptographically protected data, anti-fraud protection, and immutable digital evidence.

cards.title: EU Access
cards.description: Automated generation of EU certificates and digital passports for direct market access.

features.title: Core Features
features.intro: How the network runs day to day—production, logistics, delivery, and settlement connected in one operating model.

list.title: Smart-Lock System
list.description: QR code scanning is the primary key. Immutable proof of production with GPS validation.

list.title: Batch Tracking
list.description: Every crate tracked with Batch_ID. One-click traceability from field to customer.

list.title: Escrow Payment
list.description: Buyer funds stay in escrow until delivery is confirmed, then are released to grower and logistics partners under agreed terms. Bio Vera runs the chain as brand and supply operator—strong, fair commercial terms, not a public percentage sheet.

list.title: Digital Handshake
list.description: Customer scans QR code to confirm delivery. Automatic payment release.

list.title: Anti-Fraud Protection
list.description: GPS timestamp, device ID tracking, camera-only capture. Impossible to falsify.

list.title: EU Digital Passport
list.description: Automated generation of EU certificates. Direct market access without intermediaries.

list.title: Blockchain verification (Polygon)
list.description: Immutable proof of origin on-chain. Product passports show a verified badge and full journey. Complete.

blockchain.title: Why We Use Blockchain
blockchain.body: We use a blockchain system so our products stay faithful to you—the customer. Every step of the journey, from harvest to delivery, is recorded in a way that cannot be changed. Not by us, not by anyone inside our company. No one can alter the trail. What you see when you scan a product is the same proof we see: transparent, verifiable, and immutable.
bullets: No one can edit the trail
You verify the same data we do

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: Where we are now and where we are heading

cta.title: Partner with the network
cta.body: Work with growers, logistics partners, and buyers under one set of standards—clear handovers, traceable batches, and predictable commercial terms.

forBuyersPage.title: For Buyers
forBuyersPage.heroLead: Source fresh produce from the Bio Vera network: certified origin and a traceable batch history, not just a listing. The full catalog and ordering are in your dashboard after you register.
forBuyersPage.notShopBody: We are not a standard online store. We work with a clear, transparent process: you see what we offer, you provide your company and contact details and consent, and we take every request seriously. Read how we operate below and, when ready, express your interest at the bottom of the page so we can get in touch.
forBuyersPage.purchasesLead: From registration to delivery: a simple, transparent process.

purchasesSteps.title: Register or log in
purchasesSteps.body: Create a buyer account or sign in. Your dashboard gives you access to the full product catalog and ordering tools.

purchasesSteps.title: Browse and order
purchasesSteps.body: In the dashboard you can browse by category (fruits, vegetables, cereals, other), see origin, harvest info, and pricing. Place direct orders or use Pre-order 2026 for seasonal planning.

purchasesSteps.title: Confirm and pay
purchasesSteps.body: Orders are confirmed in Bio Vera. Payment and delivery terms are clear; we work with secure, traceable flows from farm to you.

purchasesSteps.title: Delivery and traceability
purchasesSteps.body: Track your batch via the digital passport. You see where it was harvested, when (harvest period), and how it was handled until delivery.

forBuyersPage.productsLead: We deliver a wide range of fresh fruit and vegetables (and cereals) to European markets. The full, up-to-date list with varieties, availability, and prices is in your dashboard after registration.
forBuyersPage.productsNote: Log in to your buyer dashboard to see the full catalog, place orders, or submit a pre-order for 2026.
forBuyersPage.packagingLead: We use standardized, traceable packaging that meets food safety and quality requirements.
packagingList: Bio Vera reusable crates with integrated QR codes where applicable.
Packaging types and options are visible per product in your dashboard.
Compliance with our packaging standards is verified; work bonus applies for proper use.
forBuyersPage.operateLead: We run a vertically integrated chain: from seed and cultivation to packaging, logistics, and delivery to retail.
operateList: Direct link between certified producers and buyers; no unnecessary intermediaries.
Every batch is documented: harvest date, origin, and handling are recorded and visible.
Cold chain and logistics are managed to keep produce fresh from field to destination.
We work with clear pricing and settlement: escrow until release conditions are met, then payout to partners under agreed terms.
forBuyersPage.securityLead: We protect quality, payments, and data so you can order with confidence.

securityCards.title: Payments
securityCards.desc: Structured flow: the buyer’s payment is held in escrow through Bio Vera until delivery is confirmed, then goes to grower and logistics partners under contract. We operate as the brand and supply side—no hidden fees; terms are agreed directly with Bio Vera, not an abstract marketplace layer.

securityCards.title: Contracts & compliance
securityCards.desc: Orders and pre-orders are documented. We enforce quality and packaging standards and verify compliance before release.

securityCards.title: Quality control
securityCards.desc: Field and quality checks, barcode and GPS validation, and approved inputs only. Unauthorized or non-compliant batches are blocked.

securityCards.title: Traceability
securityCards.desc: Every batch has a unique ID and digital passport. You can verify origin, harvest date, and journey at any time.

forBuyersPage.valueTitle: What you get with Bio Vera
forBuyersPage.valueLead: Our fruit and vegetables are fresh-harvested, traceable, and backed by a full digital passport.

valueBlocks.title: Our fruit and vegetables
valueBlocks.body: Sourced from Bio Vera certified producers. We focus on quality, sustainable growing methods, and compliance with our protocol.

valueBlocks.title: Fresh harvested
valueBlocks.body: Harvests are planned and reported; we aim to move produce from field to market without unnecessary delay so you receive fresh product.

valueBlocks.title: Product passport
valueBlocks.body: Each batch has a digital passport with full information: where it was harvested (region, farm), when (harvest date and period), cold chain, compliance, and the full journey from field to delivery.

valueBlocks.title: Origin and producer
valueBlocks.body: You see the farm, region, and producer behind each product. Certifications and quality entries are available in the dashboard when you order.

logisticsPartnerPage.title: For logistics
logisticsPartnerPage.heroLead: Join Bio Vera's trusted network of transport partners. Open to independent drivers, small vans, medium trucks, and large transport companies. Deliver organic products with complete traceability and earn stable, long-term contracts.

logisticsPartnerPage.fleetPolicyTitle: Bio Vera fleet standards & registering vehicles
logisticsPartnerPage.fleetPolicyP1: Under a new Bio Vera logistics rule, we are developing and operating our own branded vehicle fleet alongside contracted partners. Vehicles that carry Vera loads must visibly and technically fit that programme—consistent identity on the road, one cold-chain doctrine, auditable telemetry.
logisticsPartnerPage.fleetPolicyP2: Applying to register additional vehicles on Bio Vera logistics is only possible where there is full compliance with Bio Vera fleet requirements: prescribed truck exterior and liveries, cleanliness and sealing of the cargo compartment, refrigeration and Bio Vera-approved sensors, GPS and handover tooling, plus every other mandatory standard communicated in prospectuses and partner manuals. Vehicles that cannot meet these requirements will not be approved.
fleetStandardsBullets: Exterior and graphics: Vera-approved livery, signage and markings (see prospect PDF)
Temperature control: refrigerated body within the mandated band; verified before route assignment
Telematics: Bio Vera sensor kit/GPS workflow as documented; no unauthorised substitutes
Cargo-area hygiene & seals aligned with published organic cold-chain rules for Vera partners
All other technical checks published for the Vera fleet programme remain binding
logisticsPartnerPage.conditionsTitle: Conditions to become a Vera logistics partner
logisticsPartnerPage.conditionsLead: You must meet the following. We accept small fleets, large companies, and independent drivers.
logisticsPartnerPage.needLine: You need <s1>cooling/refrigeration systems</s1> (cold chain), digital tracking, and reliable delivery. We accept <s2>small companies</s2>, <s3>large companies</s3>, and <s4>independent drivers</s4>.

requirementItems.title: Bio Vera: from orchard to shelf
requirementItems.body: Complete end-to-end responsibility from farm pickup to retail shelf delivery. You guarantee full cold chain integrity, GPS tracking, and digital handover at every stage. No partial deliveries — you are responsible for the entire journey from field to final destination.

requirementItems.title: Cooling systems (cold chain)
requirementItems.body: Mandatory refrigeration unit capable of maintaining temperatures between 0°C and +12°C for organic product transport. Required for all partners. We accept small vans, medium trucks, and large transport vehicles — company size does not matter.

requirementItems.title: Digital tracking
requirementItems.body: Mandatory installation of Bio Vera sensors for real-time temperature monitoring and GPS tracking. Same requirement for independent drivers, small companies, and large logistics partners.

requirementItems.title: Reliability
requirementItems.body: High trust score and strict adherence to in-time delivery deadlines. Consistent performance is essential for long-term partnerships.

benefitItems.title: Fast payment

benefitItems.title: Long-term contracts

aboutPage.heroSubtitle: Transforming agriculture through technology, transparency, and trust
aboutPage.missionP1: Bio Vera works to strengthen agricultural supply chains by connecting producers worldwide directly with markets, ensuring clear standards, quality assurance, and fair compensation at every step.
aboutPage.missionP2: We believe that technology can bridge the gap between traditional farming and modern market demands, creating a sustainable ecosystem where farmers thrive, buyers trust, and consumers benefit from truly traceable, high-quality products.
aboutPage.visionP1: To become a leading vertically integrated agricultural network, setting new standards for traceability, quality assurance, and sustainable agriculture.
aboutPage.visionP2: We envision a future where every product on the shelf has a complete digital passport, where farmers receive fair compensation for their work, and where consumers can trust the origin and quality of what they purchase.

valueCards.title: Transparency
valueCards.description: Complete visibility into every step of the supply chain, from field to shelf. No hidden processes, no obscured origins.

valueCards.title: Quality first
valueCards.description: Rigorous quality standards that exceed industry expectations. Every product verified through our Protocol 360 system.

valueCards.title: Fair compensation
valueCards.description: Ensuring farmers receive fair prices for their products while maintaining competitive market rates.

valueCards.title: Sustainability
valueCards.description: Promoting sustainable farming practices and reducing waste through efficient supply chain management.

whatWeDoItems.title: Complete traceability
whatWeDoItems.body: Every product gets a digital passport with immutable proof of origin, journey, and quality. QR codes on every box connect consumers directly to the farmer who grew their food.

whatWeDoItems.title: Quality assurance
whatWeDoItems.body: Our Protocol 360 system ensures three-tier quality control: field-level soil analysis, biometric scanning at packaging, and cold chain monitoring during transport.

whatWeDoItems.title: Direct market access
whatWeDoItems.body: We eliminate intermediaries, connecting producers directly with buyers. This means better prices for farmers and guaranteed freshness for consumers.

whatWeDoItems.title: EU compliance
whatWeDoItems.body: Automated certification management, GlobalG.A.P. IFA v6 group certification facilitation, and complete compliance tracking for seamless access to markets around the world.

aboutPage.ctaBody: Whether you are a grower, supplier, logistics partner, or buyer, Bio Vera offers a place in one agricultural network—with clear processes from field to settlement.

buyers.title: Protocol 360: quality assurance system
buyers.content: Discover Bio Vera's three-tier quality control system ensuring product safety, quality, and standardization. Learn about our rigorous verification process from field to shelf.

buyers.title: Product safety & quality standards
buyers.content: Every product undergoes strict quality checks including soil analysis, biometric scanning, and cold chain monitoring. Our standards exceed industry expectations.

buyers.title: Standardization & compliance
buyers.content: All products meet EU certification standards with complete traceability. Every unit is verified through our Protocol 360 system for guaranteed quality.

buyers.title: Buyer benefits & advantages
buyers.content: Enjoy competitive pricing, guaranteed freshness, complete transparency, and direct access to producers worldwide. Build trust with your customers through verified quality.

buyers.title: Terms & conditions
buyers.content: Understand our purchase terms, delivery conditions, quality guarantees, and return policies. We ensure fair and transparent transactions.

buyers.title: How to place orders

securityPage.heroLead: Your data and transactions are protected by industry-leading security measures

measureItems.title: End-to-end encryption
measureItems.body: All data in transit is encrypted using TLS/SSL protocols. Data at rest is protected with AES-256 encryption, ensuring your information remains secure at all times.

measureItems.title: Access controls
measureItems.body: Role-based access controls ensure that users can only access data and features relevant to their role. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is available for enhanced security.

measureItems.title: Secure infrastructure
measureItems.body: Bio Vera services are hosted on secure, compliant cloud infrastructure with regular security updates, intrusion detection systems, and automated backups.

measureItems.title: Audit logging
measureItems.body: All system activities are logged and monitored. We maintain comprehensive audit trails for compliance and security incident investigation.

measureItems.title: Regular security audits
measureItems.body: We conduct regular security assessments, penetration testing, and vulnerability scans. Our security team continuously monitors for threats and responds immediately to any issues.

measureItems.title: Incident response
measureItems.body: We have established procedures for detecting, responding to, and reporting security incidents. In case of a data breach, affected users are notified within 72 hours as required by GDPR.

complianceItems.title: GDPR compliance
complianceItems.body: We are fully compliant with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Your personal data is processed lawfully, transparently, and securely. You have full control over your data and can exercise your rights at any time.

complianceItems.title: EU market standards
complianceItems.body: All products distributed through the Bio Vera network meet EU certification standards. We facilitate GlobalG.A.P. IFA v6 group certification and ensure complete compliance with food safety regulations.

complianceItems.title: ISO standards
complianceItems.body: Our processes follow ISO 27001 information security management standards. We maintain rigorous quality control and continuous improvement practices.

securityPage.dataWhatBody: We protect all personal data, transaction information, financial data, location data, and any other sensitive information you entrust to us.
securityPage.dataHowBody: Through encryption, access controls, secure infrastructure, regular audits, and comprehensive monitoring. We never sell your data and only share it as described in our Privacy Policy.
securityPage.yourRightsRich: You have the right to access, correct, delete, or port your data. You can also object to processing or request restriction. Learn more in our <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
securityPage.reportBody: If you discover a security vulnerability or have concerns about our security practices, please contact us immediately. We take all security reports seriously and will investigate promptly.
